Subject: Re: Fwd: Draft order form + insurance questions — proposed redlines

Avery —

Thanks for the summary. Quick take: we can accept the 1/2/1 limits for this initial engagement with the following conditions reflected in the Order Form or as an attached endorsement: 

1) Additional Insured: Require the contractor's insurer to endorse Redwood Inference, Inc., and "Redwood Inference, its subsidiaries and affiliates" as Additional Insured on the Commercial General Liability policy, using CG 20 10 (or equivalent) that provides ongoing operations coverage. If carrier cannot provide CG 20 10, we will accept an endorsement that: (a) lists the exact named insured wording above; (b) applies to ongoing operations; and (c) includes completed operations for a 12-month period post completion.

2) Primary & Non-Contributory: Endorsement must state the coverage is primary and non-contributory with respect to Redwood's insurance.

3) Waiver of Subrogation: We are willing to accept waiver of subrogation to the extent permitted by law for General Liability only; we will not accept waiver for Professional Liability without exception approval.

4) COI & Endorsement Timing: Require COI plus endorsement (or evidence from insurer) prior to signature/activation. If endorsement is delayed, broker must provide COI showing policy effective dates plus a letter from insurer confirming endorsement issuance within 10 business days.

5) Carrier Minimum Rating: Acceptable carriers must be A- or better (A.M. Best) — if carrier lower, escalate to Legal for review.

6) Deductible/SIR: Material self-insured retention (SIR) > $100k requires review — ask broker to disclose SIR and who is responsible for it.

I'll attach a short sample endorsement text you can propose to Nebula's broker — see AI_Endorsement_Sample.pdf. If Sales (Avery) wants to move faster, we can offer the 1/2/1 compromise with the above as non-negotiable.

Aditya Rao
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
(attachment: AI_Endorsement_Sample.pdf)
